snippet.title: Wizadore - BBC Longplay
snippet.description:
This is a longplay of Wizadore on the BBC Model B, published by Imagine in 1985. The aim of the game is to gather the 3 parts of the sword to slay the dragon. It was the first commercially sold game from Chris Roberts who would go on to do Wing Commander 5 years later.

This is a seriously difficult game and I only managed this using savestates. I've edited out the mistakes.
